1.consolidated_definition: Llamada, transporte, etc. entre lugares distantes, generalmente fuera del país. Calco de estructura, usual. Esta Carta Circular se emite con el propósito de establecer las normas a seguir por las agencias para el trámite, control y pago de facturas por concepto de llamadas telefónicas de larga distancia (Departamento de Hacienda, 17-08-05)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Long-distance communication, transportation, etc., between distant places, generally outside the country. Calque of structure, usual.

This Circular Letter is issued with the purpose of establishing the norms to be followed by agencies for the processing, control, and payment of bills related to long-distance telephone calls (Department of Treasury, 17-08-05)
